name: io.github.RafaCoelho33/web3-systemic-agent
title: Web3 Systemic Agent
description: Web3 security & DAO auditor: free bytecode/honeypot/Snapshot tools + x402 Gemini LLM deep audit.

tools.name: scan_contract_selectors
tools.description: Stage 1 Free ($0.00) deterministic EVM bytecode inspector that extracts 4-byte function selectors and flags privileged backdoors (transferOwnership, upgradeTo, mint, selfdestruct). Queries live RPC for chain_id (8453 Base, 84532 Base Sepolia, 42161 Arbitrum) unless bytecode_override (0x hex) is supplied for offline analysis; falls back to empty bytecode on RPC error. Returns JSON with is_contract, bytecode_size_bytes, selectors_found, high_risk_selectors, risk_level (HIGH, LOW, EOA), and recommendation.

target_address.description: Hex EVM address of smart contract to inspect (e.g. '0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006')

chain_id.description: EVM Chain ID (8453 for Base Mainnet, 84532 for Base Sepolia, 42161 for Arbitrum One)

bytecode_override.description: Optional raw contract runtime bytecode hex string (0x...) for offline analysis without RPC calls

tools.name: check_token_honeypot
tools.description: Stage 1 Free ($0.00) static DEX token bytecode scanner that detects blacklist traps (isBlacklisted, setBlacklist), 100% sell-tax modifiers (setTax, setFee), trading freezes (pause), and SELFDESTRUCT opcodes. Fetches live token_address bytecode on chain_id unless bytecode_override (0x hex) is provided for offline execution; returns safe EOA status if bytecode is empty. Returns JSON with is_contract, is_honeypot_suspect (bool), risk_score (0.0-10.0), threat_categories, risk_flags, and recommendation.

token_address.description: Hex EVM address of token contract to inspect for honeypot traps

chain_id.description: EVM Chain ID (8453 for Base Mainnet)

bytecode_override.description: Optional raw token runtime bytecode hex string (0x...) for offline analysis

tools.name: scan_dao_proposals
tools.description: Stage 1 Free ($0.00) governance scanner that fetches up to limit (1-20) recent Snapshot DAO proposals for space_id (e.g. arbitrumfoundation.eth, aavedao.eth, ens.eth) and extracts on-chain target addresses and calldata to spot hostile takeover payloads. Queries Snapshot GraphQL API by default, or falls back to deterministic offline fixtures when use_curated_offline=true or network fails. Returns JSON with space_id, proposals_count, proposals (id, title, target_address, calldata, value_wei, state), and recommendation.

limit.description: Maximum number of proposals to fetch (default: 3)

use_curated_offline.description: If true, returns verified realistic offline curated proposals without outbound network calls

tools.name: deep_semantic_audit
tools.description: Stage 2 Paid ($0.015 USDC standard / $0.25 USDC deep proxy + verified source via x402 on Base Mainnet) hybrid audit combining Stage 1 on-chain gatekeeping with Stage 2 Gemini LLM evaluation to verify proposal_description claims against target_address bytecode and calldata under policy_prompt. Non-idempotent due to LLM evaluation and single-use EIP-3009 x402_payment_header nonce; omitting x402_payment_header safely returns an HTTP 402 payment challenge without charging. Breaching risk_threshold (0.0-10.0) escalates decision to REJECT. Returns JSON with status, decision (APPROVE, MANUAL_REVIEW, REJECT), risk_score, reasoning, and flagged_issues.

target_address.description: Hex EVM address of smart contract under evaluation

proposal_description.description: Natural language claim or governance proposal description explaining the intent of the transaction

policy_prompt.default: Audit contract and proposal for unauthorized privilege escalation, proxy upgrades, honeypot traps, or treasury drainage.
policy_prompt.description: Security policy or governance criteria to audit against

calldata.description: Transaction hex calldata or function selector being executed

chain_id.description: EVM Chain ID (default: 8453 for Base Mainnet)

risk_threshold.description: Risk score threshold (0.0 to 10.0) above which the audit triggers rejection or alert

x402_payment_header.description: Optional Base64-encoded EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization payment header satisfying $0.015 USDC (standard) or $0.25 USDC (deep proxy + verified source) requirement

resolve_proxy.description: If true, resolves EIP-1967/1822 proxy implementation contract and inspects implementation state

fetch_verified_source.description: If true, fetches verified Solidity source code from block explorers (Etherscan, Basescan, Sourcify)

tools.name: preflight_tx_firewall
tools.description: Stage 1 Free ($0.00) pre-sign security firewall evaluating EVM transaction risks, calldata decoding, unlimited token approvals, Permit2 signatures, EIP-712 typed data phishing, Indirect Prompt Injections in untrusted calldata/descriptions, and simulated state changes via eth_call. Returns JSON with verdict (ALLOW, BLOCK, MANUAL_REVIEW), risk_score (0.0-10.0), reasons, and simulation details.

to_address.description: Target contract or recipient EVM address

chain_id.description: EVM Chain ID (default: 8453 for Base Mainnet)

eip712_typed_data.description: Optional EIP-712 typed data dictionary to inspect before signing

untrusted_text.description: Optional untrusted text or proposal description to scan for prompt injection

run_simulation.description: Whether to run eth_call simulation on chain

tools.name: inspect_proxy_and_source
tools.description: Stage 1 Free ($0.00) EIP-1967/Beacon proxy slot inspector and verified Solidity source resolver. Probes on-chain implementation, admin, beacon, owner(), and paused() states via AsyncWeb3 and retrieves verified source metadata from Sourcify/Etherscan v2 without invoking any LLM. Supports offline_mode=True for deterministic dry-run or network-free verification.

target_address.description: Hex EVM address of smart contract or proxy to inspect

chain_id.description: EVM Chain ID (8453 for Base Mainnet, 84532 for Base Sepolia, 42161 for Arbitrum One)

fetch_verified_source.description: Whether to query Sourcify/Etherscan v2 for verified Solidity source metadata

offline_mode.description: If true, returns a deterministic clean offline structure without making RPC or HTTP calls
